title: Sip if You Dare: Meet the New Dutch Bros® Halloween Drink
summary: Get ready for monster mashes with Dutch Bros' Creepy Crawler Rebel! Try this spooky blend of kiwi, blue raspberry, vanilla, and gummy worms while supplies last.
body_markdown:
## Sip if You Dare: Meet the New Dutch Bros® Halloween Drink


As spooky season reaches its peak, Dutch Bros is keeping trick-or-treaters and late-night monster-mashers fully fueled with a limited-time treat:[The Creepy Crawler Dutch Bros Rebel®](https://www.dutchbros.com/menu/seasonal-drinks/) .


The Creepy Crawler Rebel is a frightfully delicious blend of Dutch Bros Rebel® energy drink with blue raspberry, kiwi and vanilla all topped with gummy worms. Thrill-seekers can take the tart flavor to the next level by adding a Sour Shot to their drink, if they dare. This festive drink is available iced or blended at all Dutch Bros locations, while supplies last!


Find the nearest Dutch Bros on our[location page](https://www.dutchbros.com/locations) or the[DB app](https://www.dutchbros.com/rewards) !
